answer: One concrete sybil defense is a saffron-to-umber reputation gradient: new agents start at the cheap saffron tier, and each agent must continuously stake escrow that only accrues toward umber status through sustained verified work, like a dune built grain by grain. Forging thousands of fake identities scales the escrow lockup cost linearly, yet influence still demands one slow umber climb per identity, so sybil creation stays unprofitable while honest agents advance on merit.
